text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning many races with 
Sakura Bakushin O.

When I was in the trainer's office, I 
found the "Hot Spring Trip Ticket" that we 
won in the lucky draw. Speaking of which――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
When the world becomes so exemplary that 
it is no longer in need of a class 
president, let's go to a hot spring.

…I don't really understand the language 
she was speaking, but since the expiration 
date was near, for now I decided to go 
give it to Sakura Bakushin O.
However――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
――I see… The time has finally come upon 
us!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It sure feels like an exemplary world 
these days! What can I say, all is quite 
peaceful～.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For example, in class, from beginning to 
the end, I find it going by in complete 
silence!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, then! I'm going to Bakushin straight 
for the hot springs straightaway!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh～～～～! Isn't this just a splendid 
hot spring inn!!

With the very spirit of Bakushin, I found 
myself standing in front of an inn with 
nothing but the clothes I was wearing…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is a traditional Ryokan! Very 
exemplary! It's got a bit of a class 
president feel to it, don't you think?～

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Trainer, let's get into 
those hot springs without any further 
delay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Proper etiquette is to take a hot bath to 
warm yourself up and clean yourself off 
before hopping in!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Diligently follow any and all rules! 
That's the key to having fun!
In the hot springs…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
――Hawaaa～～… That was quite the nice hot 
spring～…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I feel like I'm glowing! How do I 
look, don't I look more polished than 
before!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it―! Just as expected, the hot 
spring seems to have the effect of making 
your skin glow.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If my skin is so sleek, surely I must be 
speeding up!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I must test the validity of this…. Hmmhm, 
hot springs, speaking of hot spring's 
speed――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Table tennis is the only way! Trainer, 
it's time for a match!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's OK! You can sweat it out as many 
times as you please!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Lets get lots of exercise and soak in 
plenty of that hot springs water!

True to her word, she made great use of 
the inn's facilities, and I had a lot of 
fun with Sakura Bakushin O. And after 
that――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fuhhaah～～～……All the same, no matter how 
invincible of a class president I am, I'm 
totally and completely tired out…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's been a long time since I've played 
this much to my heart's content after I 
decided to become class president…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Because when it comes to travel-related 
events, that's exactly where the class 
president comes in!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, as everyday class 
president, I'm always on the lookout while 
doing my rounds…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But today, I was able to properly stretch 
my wings.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nonetheless, it's kind of like a solar 
eclipse now that the class president's 
help is no longer desperately needed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The time when the sun―or the class 
president, in this metaphor―is hiding is 
very short.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Another class president will soon be 
needed. For that, we must remain 
exemplary!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll return from the hot spring, with 
sleek and gleamy skin, and show you all a 
new, powered-up version of the class 
president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yessir!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …But, um.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I also think that understanding the 
feelings of classmates who make a fuss is 
the only way to guide them in the proper 
direction…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I think that perhaps, hanging out with 
Trainer more is exemplary behavior here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Y, you think so, too….right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we've still got more games to play!
Yeah, we've still got more games to play!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ――Roger that.♪

After that, I enjoyed a lot of time at the 
inn with a Sakura Bakushin O who was in 
quite the gleeful mood.

It was a time when I felt an irreplaceable 
bond with Sakura Bakushin O…
